en-US.longDescription: Fiji is a "batteries-included" distribution of ImageJ—a popular, free scientific image processing application—which includes a lot of plugins organized into a coherent menu structure. Fiji compares to ImageJ as Ubuntu compares to Linux.ux.
en-US.name: Fiji ImageJ
